OBJECTIVE: bring exactly one stale test fixture in line with the parent's correct, delivered production behaviour. The parent now renders an approval dispatch control ONLY for a run the daemon bound to a goal AND stated planning material for. apps/control-room/src/shell-mode-view.test.tsx (208 lines, tracked, clean) contains ZERO occurrences of planningAuthorityByRun - measured with `git grep -c planningAuthorityByRun` - so its wire fixture never states that material and the control correctly stops rendering. Exact owned paths (1): apps/control-room/src/shell-mode-view.test.tsx

THE FAILING ASSERTIONS, verbatim, at shell-mode-view.test.tsx:198-200:
    expect(screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: /^Dispatch /u })).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(screen.getByTestId("cr.liveboard.dispatch.approval.decide")).toBeTruthy();

The rule is stated in that file's own comment: an approval control renders only for a run the daemon bound to a goal AND stated material for, so a surface must state BOTH - the valid wire facts, never a weaker expectation.
